[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 90
- Description: Brazilian federal import tax amortized into unit cost + 3 ledgers (AWB 047-3175-3223)
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1GE7PUq-UT6x2rBN-Q2ksogbWpgyuh2SaxJyG_uEK6PU/edit
  - https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1w3D0y9iPMu7kR9SuS6WNmIAym6FGUql9vUL2pD_qGR4/edit
  - https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1pdI1lMChyD2-3mEaQr8krkzQUeFQ60JMz57IbfO-qLE/edit
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1867
  
  Details:
  Amortized the Brazilian federal import tax Pix (R$674.37 → Ministério da Fazenda, ref 580850637, 18/11/2026) into landed unit cost and booked it across MAIN, AGL13 and AGL8.
  
  ## Rate derivation
  - USD cost of tax: **$116.70** (R$674.37 ÷ 5.7786, from the Wise conversion already booked at MAIN r6094/r6095, memo "Taxes to the inventory to usa")
  - Denominator: **297.06 kg** = sum of the eight NF-e nº 18 line weights (AWB 047-3175-3223, TAP TP028 SSA→SFO)
  - **Rate = $0.3928499293 / kg**
  
  Note: declared net on CI/PL Rev 15 is 302.06 kg, which is 5.00 kg more than the sum of the line weights. Allocated on actual line weights so every cent of the $116.70 lands (shares sum exactly to the total, per SOP §5.16).
  
  ## Per-ledger allocation
  | Ledger | kg | Tax (USD) |
  |---|---|---|
  | MAIN | 132.76 | 52.15475661 |
  | AGL13 | 120.50 | 47.33841648 |
  | AGL8 | 43.80 | 17.20682691 |
  | **Total** | **297.06** | **116.70000000** |
  
  ## 1. MAIN Currencies — 8 AWB-suffixed rows bumped
  | Row | Key | Old | New |
  |---|---|---|---|
  | r14 | 8 Ounce Pouch Ilhéus | 10.51 | 10.5990984 |
  | r49 | Cacao Almonds Paulo AGL8 | 35.28 | 35.6728499 |
  | r62 | Cacao Mass Bar 500g | 24.23 | 24.4264250 |
  | r80 | Cacao Nibs (KG) Ilhéus 2024 | 41.69 | 42.0828499 |
  | r83 | Cacao Nibs Santos AGL13 | 27.25 | 27.6428499 |
  | r91 | Cacao Tea Santos AGL13 | 27.25 | 27.6428499 |
  | r115 | Ceremonial Pouch 200g AGL8 | 13.78 | 13.8585700 |
  | r131 | Coopercabruca Cacao Butter (KG) | 34.40 | 34.7928499 |
  
  Both AGL `State` tabs are `=IMPORTRANGE(...Currencies!A:B)` off MAIN, so the single MAIN write propagated to all three ledgers without touching formula cells.
  
  ## 2. AGL13 + AGL8 — §5.16 Step 4 cross-ledger injection (Equity ≠ Assets)
  Three legs per ledger, matching precedent AGL8 r22–r24:
  - expense: `Gary Teh` −A, `Assets`
  - equity: `TrueSight DAO` +A, `Equity`
  - injection: `Gary Teh` +A, `Assets`
  
  | Ledger | Rows | Assets net | Equity |
  |---|---|---|---|
  | AGL13 | r76 / r77 / r78 | 0.00000000 | +47.33841648 |
  | AGL8 | r218 / r219 / r220 | 0.00000000 | +17.20682690 |
  
  Assets net to zero; the Equity leg closes against the Currencies revaluation in step 1.
  
  ## 3. MAIN — whole R$674.37 cleared
  - r6098: `Gary Teh` **−301.384775** `Brazilian Reis` — MAIN's 44.69% share
  - r6099: `Gary Teh` **−372.985225** `Brazilian Reis` — AGL13 + AGL8 shares
  
  Gary Teh's Brazilian Reis balance went **674.37 → 0** (row disappears from `offchain asset location`, which omits zero balances). USD equivalents preserved in the row descriptions.
  
  ## 4. Step 7 — Unit Costing Economics filled (both were blank)
  - AGL13: `Total Shipping cost` 273.5527671 → +47.33841648; `Cost per Unit after shipping` → **10.57519704**
  - AGL8: `Total Shipping cost` 99.43245809 → +17.2068269; `Cost per Unit after shipping` → **18.60482644**
  
  ## Verification
  All figures re-read from the live sheets after writing: 8/8 Currencies rows match target; both AGL asset nets are exactly zero; BRL balance reads 0; 301.384775 + 372.985225 = 674.37.
  
  ## Three errors self-corrected during execution
  1. First wrote `TrueSight DAO +A Assets` instead of `Gary Teh −A` + `Gary Teh +A` — inflated Assets against the revaluation; caught on re-read, fixed against precedent.
  2. Cleared the R$674.37 in **USD** instead of BRL — left the BRL balance untouched while double-charging Gary's USD against the already-booked Wise debit.
  3. Wrote asset identity as `BRL` when the ledger stores it as **`Brazilian Reis`** — rows were invisible to the balance QUERY.
  
  All three were caught only by checking the derived balance view, not by re-reading the cells I had written.
  
  ## Ledgers
  - MAIN: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1GE7PUq-UT6x2rBN-Q2ksogbWpgyuh2SaxJyG_uEK6PU/edit
  - AGL13: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1w3D0y9iPMu7kR9SuS6WNmIAym6FGUql9vUL2pD_qGR4/edit
  - AGL8: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1pdI1lMChyD2-3mEaQr8krkzQUeFQ60JMz57IbfO-qLE/edit
- Contributor(s): Sophia Truesight
- TDG Issued: 150.00
- Attached Filename: N/A
- Destination Contribution File Location: N/A
--------
